summary: Tested the new per-user extra permissions feature (/permissions screen plus PUT /api/users/{id}/custom-permissions) on both backend and frontend, and checked /manage-users for regressions. Backend: 12 of 13 tests passed. Saving works, invalid keys are filtered out, saving does not change role, role_id or permissions, reset to [] works, non-admins get 403, and the login session (/auth/me) gets the extra permissions. The one failure: an invalid ObjectId returns 500. Frontend: the list, role names (including custom role_id roles such as المدير المالي), filters, modal sections, locked base chips, saving and reopening all work. Two web bugs: (1) the reset button does nothing on web, and (2) clicking the Switch itself does not toggle it. Regression: changing the role in /manage-users works (window.alert success, role_id saved) and custom_permissions survive the role change. Existing users' permissions and custom_permissions are unchanged.

minor.issue: A user_id that is not a valid ObjectId (e.g. 'not-an-id') returns 500 because ObjectId(user_id) raises InvalidId. It should return 400 or 404.

ui_bugs.issue: The reset button (إعادة تعيين) does nothing on web. Alert.alert with buttons does nothing in react-native-web, so no confirm dialog appears, onPress never runs and the API is never called. Reproduced: after clicking, no dialog appeared, the modal stayed open and the toggle stayed ON. Fix: use window.confirm when Platform.OS === 'web', as manage-users.tsx and other screens already do.
No success or error message is shown on web, also because of Alert.alert. The save works and the modal closes, but no alert or dialog appears. Use window.alert on web.

Clicking the Switch itself toggles the permission twice: Switch onValueChange fires and the click also reaches the parent TouchableOpacity onPress, so the state ends up unchanged. Clicking the label or row works. Fix: remove onValueChange from the Switch (or make it pointerEvents none), or stop the click from reaching the row.

integration_issues.issue: getRoleInfo uses only the role document's permissions (or default_permissions[role]) and ignores the user's own `permissions` field. The backend (get_current_user) grants role-doc ∪ user.permissions ∪ custom_permissions. Example: Salim's own permissions include hr_manage_leaves, hr_manage_org, hr_manage_employees and hr_view_employees, which are not in the dean role. The screen shows them as OFF toggles even though he has them, and the card shows 34 instead of the real total. test_iso_hr2 (role 'custom', no role_id) shows 0 permissions and a raw 'custom' label while it really has 6.
For role docs with 0 permissions (مشرف قسم, الموظف العادي) the backend falls back to the system_key or default permissions, but the frontend shows no base permissions. This is an edge case.

issues: The raw English 'custom' label appears as a role name and filter chip for users with role='custom' and no role_id. Show a label such as 'دور مخصص' instead.

action_items: permissions.tsx: replace Alert.alert in handleResetPermissions with window.confirm on web (and window.alert for the success and error messages in handleSave and reset), so reset works and messages appear on web
permissions.tsx: fix the Switch double toggle inside the TouchableOpacity row (keep a single toggle handler)

permissions.tsx: include user.permissions (the user's own grants) in the base or effective set for the count and the locked chips, so users with direct grants (e.g. Salim) are shown correctly; map role 'custom' with no role_id to an Arabic label
server.py update_user_custom_permissions: validate ObjectId and return 400/404 instead of 500
critical_code_review_comments: custom_permissions is not a new field: Salim, Saeed, fee_dorm, fee_general and view_curr_user already had values from earlier sessions, and they are preserved and shown correctly as ON toggles. Using reset on Salim would wipe test-setup permissions (hr_manage_tasks, hr_manage_appraisals) that iteration_146 tests rely on.

Any non-admin user with manage_users can grant any permission, including manage_users or manage_roles, to anyone (including themselves) through this endpoint. This matches the existing trust model, but consider limiting it to admins.
GET /api/users excludes teachers and students, so this screen cannot grant extra permissions to teachers. The 'academic + admin extras' case only covers dean/department_head, which are listed.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (list, filters, modal sections, save+persist and manage-users regression pass; reset broken on web; switch click broken)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ui_hybrid (dean) for UI testing and deleted it afterwards. The pytest fixture creates and deletes TEST_cp_<ts>. Did not modify Salim, Saeed or other existing users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: admin/admin123 through the 'تسجيل الدخول' button (Enter does not submit). /permissions testIDs: permissions-filter-<roleName>, permissions-user-card-<id>, permissions-save-btn, permissions-reset-btn, permission-toggle-<key>. Click the row label text (not the switch) to toggle. Creating a dean user requires faculty_id (use 698e4f9297fef774e66e93a4). Finance role id: 6ae12b45b4d7a835c4c9b5fe. After the fix, retest reset on web (expect a window.confirm dialog) and a direct switch click.
rca of the issue: Reset and success messages: react-native-web's Alert.alert does nothing, and permissions.tsx uses it without a Platform.OS==='web' fallback (unlike manage-users.tsx). Switch: RN-web Switch is an input inside a TouchableOpacity that also toggles, so one click runs togglePermission twice.
